title: Crocodiles Climb Trees, Up to 13 Feet High

scenes.text: A 2014 study found four species doing it, on three continents.
Some climbed about four meters up, roughly 13 feet.
One crawled five meters out along a branch.
The smaller ones climbed the highest.
When people got close, they dropped straight into the water.

description:
Researchers found four crocodile species climbing trees on three continents, some about four meters up, roughly 13 feet.
They may do it to bask or to look out for threats and prey.
Would you look up before walking near a river?
first_comment: Did you know crocodiles could climb?
